clue: MS Dhoni finished off the 2011 World Cup final with a six over long-on. Where was he batting?
fact: Dhoni's 91* off 79 balls beat Sri Lanka on 2 April 2011, India's first World Cup win since 1983.

clue: Anil Kumble took all 10 wickets in a Test innings against Pakistan in February 1999. Where?
answer: Feroz Shah Kotla (Arun Jaitley Stadium), Delhi
fact: Kumble finished with 10 for 74, only the second bowler ever to take all ten in a Test innings after Jim Laker.

clue: Following on against Australia in 2001, India were saved by VVS Laxman's 281 and won the Test. Where?
fact: Laxman and Rahul Dravid batted through the whole fourth day, and Harbhajan Singh's hat-trick helped finish it.

clue: Sachin Tendulkar scored the first double century in men's ODI history, against South Africa in 2010. Where?
fact: Sachin's 200* came off 147 balls on 24 February 2010.

clue: The world's largest cricket stadium, which hosted the 2023 World Cup final, is in which city?
fact: The rebuilt Motera ground seats about 132,000 people.

clue: India's first ever Test win came against England in 1952. Where was it played?
fact: Vinoo Mankad took 12 wickets as India won by an innings and 8 runs, 20 years after their first Test.

clue: Brendon McCullum's 158* lit up the very first IPL match in April 2008. Where?
fact: Kolkata Knight Riders beat Royal Challengers Bangalore by 140 runs on IPL's opening night.

clue: India beat Pakistan in the 2011 World Cup semi-final, watched by both Prime Ministers. Where?
fact: Sachin Tendulkar top-scored with 85 and India won by 29 runs.

clue: In just his fifth ODI, MS Dhoni announced himself with 148 against Pakistan in April 2005. Where?
fact: It was Dhoni's first international hundred, made batting at number three.

clue: MS Dhoni smashed 183* to chase down 299 against Sri Lanka in October 2005. Where?
fact: Dhoni hit 10 sixes and India won with 23 balls to spare.

clue: Virender Sehwag hit 219 against West Indies in December 2011, then a world-record ODI score. Where?
fact: Sehwag's 219 came off 149 balls and stood as the ODI record until Rohit Sharma's 264 in 2014.

clue: Which Test ground sits at 1,457 metres with the snowy Dhauladhar range behind it?
fact: India played their first Test here against Australia in 2017.

clue: The world's highest cricket ground was built by the Maharaja of Patiala in 1893. Where is it?
fact: The ground sits at about 2,444 metres and is now part of Chail Military School.

clue: The Ranji Trophy honours K. S. Ranjitsinhji, Jam Sahib of a princely state. Find its capital.
fact: Ranji played for England in the 1890s; the national championship was named after him in 1934.

clue: MS Dhoni's hometown got its own international stadium in 2013. Where is it?
fact: Its first ODI was India vs England in January 2013, and India won.

clue: Sachin Tendulkar learned his cricket under coach Ramakant Achrekar on this famous maidan.
fact: Shivaji Park has also produced Sunil Gavaskar, Vinod Kambli and Ajit Wadekar.

clue: The 'home' of Rajasthan Royals moved to the Northeast for some IPL games from 2023. Which city?
fact: Guwahati became the first Northeast city to host IPL matches.

clue: West Indies played India in an ODI in October 1983 at the only men's international venue in Kashmir. Where?
fact: Srinagar hosted two men's ODIs, in 1983 and 1986.

clue: Odisha's capital hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup in both 2018 and 2023. Where?
fact: Odisha has sponsored the Indian hockey teams since 2018.

clue: India's biggest hockey stadium was built in record time for the 2023 World Cup. Where?
fact: It seats around 21,000 and is named after the tribal freedom fighter Birsa Munda.

clue: Major Dhyan Chand, the 'Wizard' of hockey, was born here in 1905.
fact: Dhyan Chand won three Olympic golds, and his birthday, 29 August, is National Sports Day.

clue: This small Punjab village near Jalandhar has produced more than a dozen hockey Olympians.
fact: Sansarpur players have represented India, Kenya and Canada at the Olympics.

clue: Mohun Bagan's barefoot players beat the East Yorkshire Regiment in the 1911 IFA Shield final. Where?
fact: The 2–1 win made Mohun Bagan the first Indian club to win the IFA Shield.

clue: The Durand Cup, Asia's oldest football tournament, began in 1888 in the hills near which city?
fact: It was started by Sir Mortimer Durand, then Foreign Secretary in British India.

clue: The 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup final, England 5–2 Spain, was played where?
fact: Over 66,000 fans watched the final, and the tournament set an U-17 attendance record.

clue: Kerala Blasters pack their famous 'Manjappada' crowds into which stadium?
fact: In ISL's early seasons Kochi regularly drew crowds above 50,000.

clue: FC Goa play home games at this stadium in Margao.
fact: Goa has one of India's oldest club football cultures, with Salgaocar, Dempo and Churchill Brothers.

clue: The Tata Football Academy, launched in 1987, became a pioneer of Indian youth football. Where?
fact: Jamshedpur FC now plays in the ISL at the nearby JRD Tata Sports Complex.

clue: Aizawl FC became the first Northeast club to win the I-League, in 2016–17. Where are they based?
fact: Mizoram is one of India's football heartlands, and Aizawl beat the big Kolkata clubs to the title.

clue: A stadium in South Sikkim is named after Bhaichung Bhutia, while he was still playing. Which town?
fact: Bhaichung Bhutia captained India and became the first Indian to play professionally in England.

clue: Pro Kabaddi League's first match, U Mumba vs Jaipur Pink Panthers, was held in July 2014. Which city?
fact: Jaipur Pink Panthers went on to win that first season.

clue: British officers learned modern polo from players in this northeastern city in the 1850s.
fact: Mapal Kangjeibung is considered the world's oldest polo ground still in use.

clue: Vijender Singh's 2008 Olympic boxing bronze put this Haryana town, called 'mini Cuba', on the map.
fact: The Bhiwani Boxing Club has produced several Olympic and Commonwealth medallists.

clue: Neeraj Chopra, India's first Olympic gold medallist in athletics, grew up in Khandra village near which city?
fact: His 87.58 m throw won gold at Tokyo 2020 on 7 August 2021.

clue: PT Usha, the 'Payyoli Express', is named after her home town. Where is it?
fact: Usha missed a 400 m hurdles bronze by 1/100th of a second at the 1984 Olympics.

clue: The first Asian Games opened in March 1951 at this stadium.
fact: Now the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, it sits at the end of Kartavya Path near India Gate.

clue: India hosted Formula 1's Indian Grand Prix from 2011 to 2013. Where was the track?
fact: Sebastian Vettel won all three Indian Grands Prix.

clue: The 44th Chess Olympiad in 2022 was hosted in a seaside temple town. Which one?
fact: India hosted the Olympiad for the first time and won two bronze medals.

clue: Viswanathan Anand, India's first grandmaster, was born in which Tamil Nadu town?
fact: Anand was born in December 1969 and grew up in Chennai.

clue: PV Sindhu and Saina Nehwal trained at Pullela Gopichand's academy in which city?
fact: Gopichand, the 2001 All England champion, opened the academy in 2008.

clue: British officers first wrote down badminton's rules in this city, giving the early game its name.
fact: The rules were drafted in the 1870s, and the game was called 'Poona' before Badminton House gave it a new name.

clue: Lakshya Sen, 2021 World Championships bronze medallist, was born in this Uttarakhand hill town.
fact: Lakshya's grandfather is credited with introducing badminton to Almora.

clue: Huge snake boats race in the Nehru Trophy Boat Race every August. Where?
fact: The race began after Jawaharlal Nehru watched one in 1952 and donated the trophy.

clue: Jallikattu's best-known arena, held each Pongal, is in this village near Madurai.
fact: Tamil Nadu passed a law in 2017 to keep Jallikattu legal.

clue: Kambala jockey Srinivas Gowda went viral for racing buffaloes in this coastal region. Find Moodbidri.
fact: His 2020 run of 100 m in about 9.55 seconds led to 'Usain Bolt' comparisons.

clue: The skiing events of the Khelo India Winter Games are held on these Kashmir slopes.
fact: Gulmarg's gondola reaches nearly 4,000 m on Mount Apharwat.

clue: Ice hockey at the Khelo India Winter Games is played on natural rinks in this Ladakh town.
fact: Ladakh's ice hockey teams play outdoors at about 3,500 m.

clue: Asia's largest sports institute, the National Institute of Sports, is housed in a former palace. Where?
fact: The National Institute of Sports was founded in 1961 and trains many of India's national coaches.
